name: triage
description: Moves issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill, and write agent-ready briefs. Use when the user says \"triage this issue\" or wants agent-ready issue briefs.
author: FradSer
summary_zh: 一个帮助团队分流和审核 Issue、外部 PR，并整理成可直接交给 AI 代理处理的任务简报工具。
